about: Which generated files each Peskas repo gets, and where. Keys are the repos' folder names next to peskas-context; each pair is [file in dictionary/, path in that repo]. sync.py copies them; sync.py --check reports any that differ.

peskas.dashboard.after: AskFish reads the new catalog once the dashboard deploys; run the dashboard's tests (pnpm --filter @repo/api test) first.
